sentiment_score_definition: x <= -0.35: Bearish; -0.35 < x <= -0.15: Somewhat-Bearish; -0.15 < x < 0.15: Neutral; 0.15 <= x < 0.35: Somewhat_Bullish; x >= 0.35: Bullish
relevance_score_definition: 0 < x <= 1, with a higher score indicating higher relevance.

feed.title: Glucotrack shareholders approve stock issuance proposals and amend warrant terms
feed.summary: Glucotrack shareholders approved two proposals for issuing common stock and amended warrant terms with an investor, as revealed in a recent SEC filing. These approvals are crucial for the company, which is facing significant financial challenges, including a 95.6% year-to-date stock plunge and a low market capitalization, and are intended to ensure compliance with Nasdaq listing rules. The company also recently completed a business combination with Lōkahi Therapeutics and secured bridge financing, alongside receiving a Notice of Allowance for a patent application related to its continuous glucose monitoring system.

feed.title: Form 8K GlucoTrack Inc For: 14 September By Investing.com
feed.summary: This article announces that GlucoTrack Inc. has filed a Form 8K on September 14, 2026. The filing is available through Investing.com, indicating a significant corporate event for the company. The article includes stock market data for GlucoTrack Inc. (GCTK).

feed.title: Wells Fargo commercial banking head Manning to retire, Biodrowski to succeed
feed.summary: John Manning, Wells Fargo's executive vice president and head of commercial banking market coverage, is set to retire at the end of 2026 after over 30 years with the bank. Rob Biodrowski, currently a division executive for the U.S. Midwest commercial banking, will succeed Manning starting in November. Biodrowski will lead more than 2,000 bankers serving clients across the U.S. and Canada, focusing on companies with annual revenues from $25 million to $2 billion.

feed.title: Wells Fargo commercial banking head Manning to retire, Biodrowski to succeed
feed.summary: John Manning, Wells Fargo's executive vice president and head of commercial banking market coverage, will retire at the end of the year after over 30 years with the bank. Rob Biodrowski, currently a division executive for the U.S. Midwest, will succeed Manning starting in November. Biodrowski will lead more than 2,000 bankers serving clients across the U.S. and Canada.

feed.title: Netflix Stock Rose 4% While the AI Trade Sold Off on Monday. Its Capital Goes Into Shows, Not Silicon.
feed.summary: Netflix stock rose 4% on Monday while AI-related stocks experienced a sell-off, driven by investor concerns about the high costs associated with AI development. Unlike AI companies, Netflix's significant capital expenditures are directed towards content creation rather than silicon and data centers. The streaming giant's strong free cash flow and stock repurchase program further highlight its financial health, though slowing revenue growth remains a key concern for its long-term stock performance.

feed.title: Deere recalls 375 workers to boost inventory ahead of contract talks
feed.summary: John Deere is rehiring 375 workers in the Quad Cities to build inventory in anticipation of upcoming labor negotiations, following the United Auto Workers' rejection of a contract extension due to job security concerns. This move comes after Deere laid off over 2,000 workers since April 2024 amidst an agricultural downturn. The company aims to ensure uninterrupted customer service and equipment access during future talks with the UAW.

feed.title: Working to Avoid Strike, Boeing Advances Another SPEEA Offer
feed.summary: Boeing is highly motivated to avoid a strike by its white-collar engineers and technicians, represented by SPEEA, as a labor disruption could hinder 737 MAX production and certification progress for the MAX 10 and 777X. The company has presented a new "final offer" to SPEEA, including a 10% guaranteed wage increase and annual wage pools. Meanwhile, machinists in Wichita, formerly with Spirit AeroSystems, have voted to rejoin the main IAM union contract, seeking equal footing with their Pacific Northwest counterparts.

feed.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces an Investigation Against Baidu, Inc. (BIDU) and Encourages Shareholders to Learn More About the Investigation
feed.summary: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC has launched an investigation into potential claims against Baidu, Inc. (BIDU) following several significant drops in its American Depositary Share (ADS) price. These declines occurred after reports of Baidu being added to a list of companies aiding the Chinese military, and subsequent financial results showing year-over-year revenue decreases and increased competition in its advertising business. The firm encourages shareholders to participate in the investigation regarding their losses.

feed.title: Billionaire Investor Adds To ASML, Exits Rivals KLA and Lam — Plus Nvidia, Broadcom
feed.summary: Billionaire investor Dan Loeb's Third Point LLC significantly increased its stake in ASML Holding during the second quarter of 2026, more than doubling its previous holdings. Concurrently, Third Point divested its entire positions in ASML's competitors, including NVIDIA, Broadcom, KLA Corporation, and Lam Research. This strategic move follows ASML's strong second-quarter earnings, raised full-year outlook, and expanded partnerships with Intel and Samsung.

feed.title: John W. Rose sells Alphabet Inc. stock worth between $250,001 and $500,000
feed.summary: John W. Rose, a U.S. Congressman from Tennessee, sold Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL) stock valued between $250,001 and $500,000 on June 3, 2025. The transaction, conducted through his Raymond James Brokerage Account, was disclosed as required by the STOCK Act. While Alphabet Inc. remains a strong company with a robust balance sheet, the sale does not necessarily indicate Rose's view on the company's future, as congressional members' stock transactions can be influenced by various personal and financial factors.

feed.title: Coca-Cola Stock Is Up 29% in 2026: What Will It Take to Break Through $100?
feed.summary: Coca-Cola stock has surged 29% in 2026, outperforming competitors and the broader market, driven by 5% global volume growth and raised full-year EPS guidance. Trading at $89.06, KO is approaching the psychological $100 mark, with its recent Q2 performance highlighting strong execution and market share gains against a weakening consumer backdrop for peers like PepsiCo. Achieving the $100 milestone likely depends on sustained volume growth in Q3 and an expanded valuation multiple.

feed.title: Insider Selling: Invesco (NYSE:IVZ) Director Sells $97,320.00 in Stock
feed.summary: Invesco Ltd. Director Phoebe Wood sold 3,000 shares of the company's stock for a total of $97,320.00, reducing her position by 2.72%. Following the transaction, Wood directly owned 107,111 shares. The company recently reported strong quarterly earnings, beating consensus estimates, and declared a quarterly dividend of $0.215.

feed.title: First Interstate BancSystem (NASDAQ:FIBK) Major Shareholder Jonathan Scott Sells 16,929 Shares of Stock
feed.summary: Jonathan Scott, a major shareholder in First Interstate BancSystem (NASDAQ:FIBK), sold 16,929 shares of the company's stock for approximately $626,881, reducing his stake by 2.01%. The sale occurred on September 11th at an average price of $37.03 per share. The company recently reported strong quarterly earnings, beating analyst estimates, and pays a quarterly dividend of $0.47, equating to a 5.0% yield, despite analysts generally holding a "Reduce" rating for the stock.

feed.title: Patient Monitoring Stocks Q2 Teardown: ResMed (NYSE:RMD) Vs The Rest
feed.summary: This article analyzes the Q2 earnings of patient monitoring stocks, focusing on ResMed (NYSE:RMD), iRhythm Technologies (NASDAQ:IRTC), Insulet (NASDAQ:PODD), and DexCom (NASDAQ:DXCM). It highlights their revenue performance against analyst expectations, stock reactions, and the broader industry trends including growth drivers like chronic disease prevalence and digital health, and challenges such as high R&D costs and pricing pressures. While the sector generally reported strong Q2 results, individual stock performances varied significantly post-earnings.

feed.title: CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks surging today as AI doomsday fears jolt cybersecurity stocks
feed.summary: Shares of cybersecurity companies CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks surged significantly today, driven by increasing concerns over AI-related security risks. The rise follows warnings from tech leaders about AI development, particularly after an autonomous AI breach. While some like Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei advocate for slowing AI progress, CrowdStrike CEO George Kurtz emphasized securing AI rather than hindering its development.

feed.title: John W. Rose sells Alphabet Inc. stock worth between $250,001 and $500,000
feed.summary: John W. Rose, a U.S. Congressman, sold Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ: GOOGL) Class A Common Stock valued between $250,001 and $500,000 on June 3, 2025. The transaction, conducted through his Raymond James Brokerage Account, is a significant trade from a leading technology company, although congressional members' stock transactions can be influenced by various personal and financial factors. Alphabet Inc. is noted for its strong balance sheet and a 41% return over the past year, though InvestingPro analysis suggests the stock is currently overvalued.

feed.title: DD's Discounts to make Michigan debut in Dearborn
feed.summary: DD's Discounts is opening its first Michigan store in Dearborn on September 26, located in the Fairlane North Shopping Center. This new store, owned by Ross Stores Inc., will offer clothing, shoes, accessories, and home goods at discounted prices. A new Ross Dress for Less store will also open nearby on October 10 as part of Ross Stores' nationwide expansion plan.

feed.title: Texas Instruments Is Up 55% in 2026: This Is the Secret Tech Stock You’re Missing Out On
feed.summary: Texas Instruments (TXN) has seen its stock rise 55% year-to-date in 2026, significantly outperforming the S&P 500, despite not being an AI compute chip specialist. This growth is attributed to strong analog and embedded processing demand across industrial, data center, and automotive sectors, along with strategic fab capacity investments during a downturn and customer-by-customer price increases. The company's performance highlights its unique market position and operational advantages over rivals.

feed.title: Apple releases test of redesigned Siri AI before iPhone 18 hits stores this week
feed.summary: Apple has released iOS 27, featuring a redesigned Siri AI personal assistant, in beta ahead of the iPhone 18 launch. This new Siri leverages large language models for personalized searches of local data and general queries, with Apple emphasizing its "personal intelligence" and integration into its ecosystem. While it uses smaller, on-device models, more complex tasks will utilize Private Cloud Compute powered by Google Cloud infrastructure.

feed.title: The NY Creates and Micron Technology Joint Apprenticeship program welcomes first cohort
feed.summary: NY Creates and Micron Technology have welcomed the first cohort of 10 apprentices to their joint workforce development program, which was announced in April by Governor Kathy Hochul. This 16-month program provides hands-on training, education, and mentorship to prepare participants for technician roles in the semiconductor industry, particularly at Micron's new megafab in Clay, New York. The initiative aims to build a skilled talent pipeline to support domestic memory manufacturing expansion and strengthen New York's position in high-tech innovation.

feed.title: Bank of America CEO sees at least 10% drop in Q3 investment banking fees By Reuters
feed.summary: Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan anticipates at least a 10% decrease in investment banking fees for the third quarter, projecting revenue between $1.6 billion and $1.8 billion, down from $2 billion in the previous year. Despite a strong deals pipeline, Moynihan noted that potential interest rate hikes could slow financing demand. Sales and trading revenue is expected to remain flat, while consumer spending and credit quality are reported to be robust.

feed.title: PHILLIPS 66 TEAMSTERS TO RALLY FOR FAIR CONTRACT
feed.summary: Teamsters Local 877 representing 370 oil refinery workers at Phillips 66 Bayway Refinery will rally on September 15, 2026, to demand a fair contract. Their current agreement expires on October 1, and workers are seeking higher wages, stronger benefits, and the elimination of an Absence Control Policy. The rally precedes negotiations scheduled for September 16.

feed.title: Centene Corp stock hits 52-week high at 69.36 USD By Investing.com
feed.summary: Centene Corp (CNC) stock hit a 52-week high of $69.36, reflecting a robust 1-year total return of nearly 100% and a 93% surge over the past six months, bringing its market capitalization to $34.2 billion. Analysts have revised earnings upwards, and the stock is considered undervalued by InvestingPro. Recent analyst upgrades and increased price targets from firms like Truist Securities, Bernstein SocGen Group, Argus, and Cantor Fitzgerald underscore a positive sentiment regarding Centene's future performance, driven by improved financial metrics and strategic initiatives.

feed.title: Construction begins on Royal Caribbean’s next massive Icon-class ship
feed.summary: Royal Caribbean has officially started construction on its fifth Icon-class ship at the Meyer Turku shipyard in Finland, with the vessel slated for a 2028 debut. This new ship will join its sisters, including the Port Canaveral-based Star of the Seas, in tying for the title of the world's largest cruise ship. The construction milestone was marked by a traditional keel-laying ceremony, signifying the ongoing strong partnership between Royal Caribbean and Meyer Turku.

feed.title: Qualcomm (QCOM) Surges 6% Intraday, Adding ~$11 Billion in Market Value
feed.summary: Qualcomm (QCOM) experienced a significant 6% intraday surge, adding approximately $11 billion to its market value. This unusual single-session jump for a megacap chipmaker suggests strong buying interest, with the stock holding its gains throughout the day. Investors are closely watching the closing price and volume to determine if this move represents genuine repositioning by buyers.

feed.title: Can AI Keep ISRG Ahead of Rising Robotic Surgery Competition?
feed.summary: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) is leveraging AI, software, and data to enhance its da Vinci ecosystem and maintain its lead in the competitive robotic surgery market. The company is focusing on continuous software updates, AI-driven insights, and advanced instrumentation to differentiate its platform. Competitors like Globus Medical (GMED) and Stereotaxis (STXS) are also integrating AI into their surgical intelligence and robotic ecosystems, signaling a broader industry shift towards intelligent digital surgery.

feed.title: Here's Why You Should Retain DexCom Stock in Your Portfolio for Now
feed.summary: DexCom (DXCM) is well-positioned for growth due to the significant potential of the continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) market, strong first-quarter 2026 performance, and a robust international presence. Despite competition, the company's shares have outperformed the industry and the S&P 500. Key growth drivers include strong global demand, potential expansion into the non-insulin Type 2 market with the CONNECT trial, and product differentiation from the G7 15 Day system.

feed.title: Jonathan R. Scott Sells 16,929 Shares of First Interstate BancSystem (NASDAQ:FIBK)
feed.summary: Jonathan R. Scott, a director and 10% shareholder of First Interstate BancSystem Inc (NASDAQ:FIBK), sold 16,929 shares of common stock on September 11, 2026. The shares were sold at a weighted average price of $37.03, ranging from $37.00 to $37.23. Following this transaction, Scott indirectly retains beneficial ownership of 825,809 shares held across various trusts and entities.

feed.title: Freedom Capital Markets Downgrades Frequency Electronics(FEIM.US) to Hold Rating, Raises Target Price to $91
feed.summary: Freedom Capital Markets has downgraded Frequency Electronics (FEIM.US) from a Buy to a Hold rating, while simultaneously increasing its target price from $84 to $91. This adjustment reflects a revised outlook despite the higher price target.

feed.title: Bank of America at Barclays conference: consumer strength drives growth
feed.summary: Bank of America presented at the Barclays 24th Annual Global Financial Services Conference, highlighting strong consumer spending and wage growth as key drivers for its business. CEO Brian Moynihan noted the U.S. economy's resilience despite slower capital markets activity and rising expenses, with the bank expanding its AI use and reaffirming medium-term financial targets. The bank emphasized its robust deposit base and strategic investments, including a $250 billion infrastructure financing commitment and a $1.9 billion investment in India.

feed.title: Ford recalls 223,000 F-150 trucks due to fuel tank issues
feed.summary: Ford is recalling approximately 223,000 F-150 pickup trucks. The recall is due to potential fuel tank issues that could pose a safety risk. This action highlights Ford's ongoing efforts to address vehicle safety and quality concerns.

feed.title: GE Vernova and Corning among market cap stock movers on Monday
feed.summary: Monday's market saw significant movement in various stocks, with Zscaler and Roblox rallying, while Corning and Teradyne experienced declines. The article highlights key movers across mega-cap, large-cap, mid-cap, and small-cap categories, attributing swings to news and other market factors. Notably, GE Vernova faced a "sell" rating from GLJ Research due to cycle concerns, contributing to its decline.

feed.title: Donegal Group CEO Kevin Gerard Burke Exercises 24,000 Options and Sells Shares on September 11, 2026
feed.summary: Donegal Group Inc.'s President and CEO, Kevin Gerard Burke, exercised 24,000 stock options at $14.39 per share and simultaneously sold all 24,000 shares at $19.226 per share on September 11, 2026. Following these transactions, Burke directly holds 13,870 shares of Class A Common Stock and indirectly holds 3,342 shares through a 401(k) Plan. This series of transactions reduced his derivative options position from 24,000 to zero.

feed.title: Invesco Director Phoebe Wood Reports Sale of 3,000 Shares at $32.44 Each
feed.summary: Phoebe A. Wood, a director at Invesco Ltd. (NYSE:IVZ), sold 3,000 common shares at $32.44 each on September 11, 2026. This transaction was an open market sale, leaving her with 107,111.157 shares directly held. The disclosure was filed with the SEC, confirming no derivative securities transactions.

feed.title: General Motors digital business could be worth more than Wall Street thinks
feed.summary: UBS has raised its price target for General Motors (GM) to $114 from $102, citing the significant and growing value of the company's digital business. The bank forecasts GM's total digital revenue to reach $9.6 billion by 2036, driven by high-margin recurring revenue from services like OnStar and Super Cruise. This digital segment is expected to contribute substantially to GM's EBIT and warrants a higher valuation multiple.

feed.title: Donegal Mutual Insurance buys $1.05m of Donegal Group stock By Investing.com
feed.summary: Donegal Mutual Insurance Co., a significant owner of Donegal Group Inc. (NASDAQ:DGICA), recently purchased 54,725 shares of the company's Class A common stock for over $1 million. This insider transaction occurred on September 11, 2026, with shares bought in two blocks at prices between $19.226 and $19.254. The purchase comes as Donegal Group reported a 32% increase in its second-quarter profit, driven by lower weather-related losses and stronger investment income.

feed.title: TE Connectivity's Corporate Controller Reports Acquisition of Dividend Equivalent RSUs
feed.summary: TE Connectivity's Corporate Controller, Reuben M. Shaffer, acquired 5.2444 restricted stock units (RSUs) on September 11, 2026, as dividend equivalents. These RSUs increase his total beneficial ownership to 1,430.3995 units and convert to common shares on a one-for-one basis upon vesting. The transaction was detailed in a statement of changes in beneficial ownership filed on September 14, 2026.

feed.title: Verizon Wireless, T-Mobile resolve lawsuits over ad campaigns
feed.summary: Verizon Wireless and T-Mobile have settled lawsuits accusing each other of misleading consumers with advertising campaigns that promised significant savings from switching cellphone carriers. The dismissal of Verizon's lawsuit and T-Mobile's countersuit was filed in Manhattan federal court after a preliminary injunction favored Verizon. The settlement reportedly included discussions about a framework to resolve similar future advertising disputes.

feed.title: Kimberly-Clark preps for asset sale tied to $48B Kenvue purchase
feed.summary: Kimberly-Clark may need to sell off some assets to gain regulatory approval for its $48.7 billion acquisition of Kenvue, the maker of Tylenol. The deal has already been approved in Australia, and the European Commission is currently reviewing it. The article also touches upon the potential timeline for the deal's closure and related news about Kenvue's job cuts prior to the acquisition.

feed.title: Netflix Climbs 4%, Alphabet Ticks Up, Amazon Barely Budges as New Streaming Policy Alliance Launches
feed.summary: Netflix stock surged 4% after the company co-founded the Streaming Access and Choice Alliance, aiming to challenge the antitrust exemption that currently prevents it from bidding on live sports rights. While Netflix sees significant potential upside from this policy shift for its advertising ambitions and content offerings, Amazon barely moved and Alphabet gained only 3%, reflecting the relatively minor impact on their core businesses compared to Netflix's subscription streaming focus. The alliance initiates a long-term lobbying effort, with investors watching for regulatory actions from the Justice Department and FCC regarding the Sports Broadcasting Act.

feed.title: 'They Don't Call It an Extra Value Meal for Nothing': McDonald's Pitches $8 Big Macs as Diesel Hits $6.23
feed.summary: McDonald's is promoting an $8 Big Mac meal to attract customers while facing record-high diesel prices, which are driving up supply chain costs for franchisees. This strategy collides with McDonald's Q2 FY2026 earnings showing decelerated global comparable sales and negative U.S. guest counts, leading to a 14% year-to-date stock drop. CEO Chris Kempczinski admitted to execution issues and a slow recovery, noting that about a third of locations didn't follow value pricing recommendations.

feed.title: Enlight Renewable Energy (NASDAQ:ENLT) Insider Sells 4,329 Shares of Stock
feed.summary: Enlight Renewable Energy insider Amit Paz sold 4,329 shares of ENLT stock for approximately $331,472, reducing his ownership by 1.52%. The stock is currently trading below its 50- and 200-day moving averages and has a high price-to-earnings ratio, with analysts giving it an average "Hold" rating despite some "Buy" recommendations.

feed.title: Southwest Airlines launches sale with up to 40% off fares
feed.summary: Southwest Airlines has launched its "Week of WOW" sale, offering up to 40% off base fares for flights between October 5, 2026, and March 3, 2027. The promotion also includes discounts on rental cars through Enterprise and hotel stays, along with savings on Getaways vacation packages. Customers must book flights by September 17, 2026, with a 21-day advance purchase.

feed.title: Bank of America expects investment banking fees to fall 10% By Investing.com
feed.summary: Bank of America anticipates a decline in its third-quarter investment banking fees, projecting them to fall by at least 10% to between $1.6 billion and $1.8 billion, down from $2 billion last year. CEO Brian Moynihan attributed this expected decline to broader market conditions, noting that the overall investment banking market is down by about 10%. Moynihan also mentioned that consumer credit quality remains strong, with affordability being a key concern for consumers, while the sales and trading division is expected to see flat results year-over-year.

feed.title: FTK Investor Alert: Flotek Industries, Inc. Securities Class Action Notice - Contact Levi & Korsinsky
feed.summary: Levi & Korsinsky, LLP has filed a class action lawsuit against Flotek Industries, Inc. (NYSE: FTK) on behalf of investors who purchased securities between August 3, 2026, and August 17, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Flotek made materially false and misleading statements regarding a projected $400 million revenue backlog from a Puerto Rico power agreement, which was subsequently terminated. Shareholders who suffered losses due to a nearly 30% stock decline after the contract unwind are encouraged to contact Levi & Korsinsky to potentially recover their losses, with a lead plaintiff deadline of October 26, 2026.

feed.title: FEMSA ADRs Rise on $280 Million Accelerated Share Repurchase Agreement
feed.summary: Fomento Económico Mexicano (FEMSA) ADRs rose by 3.1% to $120.62 following the company's announcement of an accelerated share repurchase agreement worth up to $280 million. The Mexican retail and beverages company plans to repurchase American depositary shares, with the exact number dependent on their daily volume-weighted average price and expected to be settled by year-end. This move has contributed to a 19% year-to-date increase in FEMSA's ADRs.

feed.title: Corning Tumbles 12% on $2B At-the-Market Equity Offering; Coherent Sinks 11%, Lumentum Drops 9%, Fabrinet Slides 6%
feed.summary: Corning's stock plunged 12% following the announcement of a $2 billion at-the-market equity offering, impacting the broader AI optical sector. Other companies like Coherent, Lumentum, and Fabrinet also saw significant declines, partly due to sector sympathy and concerns raised by AI lab figures about slowing frontier capability development. This market reaction highlights uncertainty around the equity offering's impact and the future of AI-capex spending.

feed.title: MEDITECH Expanse EHR Live Across First Full U.S. Divisions of HCA Healthcare
feed.summary: MEDITECH has successfully implemented its Expanse electronic health record (EHR) platform across 34 hospitals in HCA Healthcare’s Capital and North Florida divisions. This marks the first two full U.S. divisions of HCA Healthcare to adopt the platform, bringing the total number of HCA hospitals using Expanse in the U.S. and U.K. to 72. The cloud-based system aims to enhance workflow efficiencies, care coordination, and data-driven decision-making for clinicians.

feed.title: Ramnik Bajaj – Senior Vice President & Chief Data Officer
feed.summary: Ramnik Bajaj is the Senior Vice President and Chief Data Officer at Delta Air Lines, leading the Enterprise Data and AI Office to advance the company's data and AI strategy. He is responsible for data governance, development, and management to support analytics, machine learning, and generative AI initiatives. Bajaj previously held similar leadership roles at USAA and Wells Fargo Bank, and was a Partner at Deloitte Consulting LLP, bringing over 20 years of experience in driving business value through data and AI solutions.

feed.title: Form 8K Curtiss-Wright Corp For: 14 September By Investing.com
feed.summary: The article is a financial filing notification from Investing.com, announcing a Form 8K filing for Curtiss-Wright Corp on September 14. It includes a brief mention of the company's stock performance and is primarily a news item about the regulatory filing.
